template.name: Target Inspection Photo Pass
template.description: One drone reaches a ground target, faces it and photographs it. Targets must already exist in the scenario; this template never creates them.
template.content: Take {drone_name} off to {random_alt:25:35:1} meters and fly it to the target {target_name}. Once the drone is over the target, point it at the target and take two photographs of {target_name}. The drone should finish hovering above the target.
content_aliases: Inspect {target_name}: {drone_name} climbs to {random_alt:25:35:1} m, reaches the target and shoots two photos of it.
{drone_name} must reach {target_name}, point at it and capture two photographs from above {random_alt:25:35:1} m.
Photo pass on {target_name} by {drone_name}, altitude {random_alt:25:35:1} m, two images required.
template.creator: Xie Qidong
